subject: hoverPickup
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: militarized pickup converted to hover thrusters.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.
reasoning:
I'm planning a militarized hover pickup design with no wheels, four corner hover thruster pods with glowing rings, an armored body, roof turret, neon accents, and decals, keeping the module compact but visually rich using the builder SDK's parts, joints, and glow kit.

Working out dimensions and skeleton structure now: chassis root, thruster hinge joints, turret yaw/pitch, with the hull built from tapered frustum boxes for the lower body and a raked cab/windscreen greenhouse shape.

I'm fleshing out the bed with ribbed walls, a sloped hood, and the thruster pods -- each a lathe-profiled nacelle bell with a glowing torus ring underneath and a spinning fan joint holding blades inside, strutted to the hull so the pods just touch the floor.

Adding the spinning fan blades above the pod with a strut connecting it to the chassis, then building out the turret with yaw/pitch joints, twin glowing barrels, roof light bar, antenna, and side neon strips. I'm also laying in headlights, tail lights, rear thruster nozzles, hood vents, and armor plates with a gunmetal color palette for the body.

Now I'm adding cyberpunk magenta/cyan accents, panelled worn-metal paint, hazard chevron stripes on the bumper, and SVG decals for the unit number, logo, and screen textures placed on side panels. Writing geometry placement code...
